notes.subject: משתין בקיר
notes.rationale: 'man i pisin long wal' — idiom bilong tok olgeta man; ol tanim tok i putim 'olgeta man' o 'pikinini man', tasol Hibru i tok gut long pisin long wal.

notes.subject: ובערתי אחריך
notes.rationale: 'mi rausim olgeta ol i stap bihain bilong yu' — KJV 'take away thy posterity', JPS 'utterly sweep thee away'; verb בער i min rausim olgeta olsem paia i kukim.

notes.subject: Ahap
notes.rationale: Eliya i tokim Ahap dairek long dispela tok bilong Yahwe.

translation: Lukim, mi bringim nogut samting i kam long yu, na mi rausim olgeta bilong yu bilong bihain, na bai mi katim long ol man bilong Ahap olgeta man i pisin long wal, na ol ⟨i⟩ pas long haus, na ol i stap ausait, long Yisrael.

tokens.gloss: ol i stap bihain bilong yu
na ol i pas long haus
